_howto: Add one object per resource. category is a short label, or a list of labels to show a resource under several filters, (it becomes a filter; filters appear in the order categories first show up here). Optional: backup (a less prominent backup copy link), extra ({label, url} for a second link such as the creator's site). Set affiliate to true for any paid/affiliate link; it gets a visible label and rel=sponsored.
